recommended_method: Flood/Continuous submergence or AWD (Alternate Wetting & Drying)
schedule_guideline: 2-5 cm standing water during vegetative stage; AWD saves water without yield loss
notes: Maintaining shallow standing water during flowering is critical; avoid stress at panicle initiation.

schedule_guideline: 4-6 irrigations at critical growth stages (CRI, tillering, flowering, grain filling)
notes: Crown root initiation (CRI) stage irrigation is the most critical for yield.

schedule_guideline: Irrigate at 50-60% depletion of available soil moisture
notes: Avoid water stress during flowering and boll development; drip irrigation improves water-use efficiency.

schedule_guideline: Frequent irrigation every 7-10 days depending on soil and season
notes: High water requirement crop; drip irrigation with fertigation significantly improves efficiency.

schedule_guideline: Light, frequent irrigation; avoid water stress during flowering/fruit set
notes: Irregular watering increases blossom-end rot and fruit cracking.

schedule_guideline: Critical stages: pegging and pod development
notes: Avoid waterlogging; groundnut is sensitive to excess soil moisture at sowing.
